critical_code_review_comments: OutreachSettingsIn.daily_email_limit is capped at 1000 (le=1000). Requirement wording says 5000 should return 422 — currently 5000 correctly rejects, but the copy 'up to 1000/day' is enforced. Confirm this is the desired ceiling.

run-now endpoint mutates state when dry_run is omitted (default False). Consider making dry_run default True or requiring an explicit confirmation flag to reduce blast radius for accidental invocations from admin UI or curl.

_run_mira_action LLM path executes actions purely based on model output — a stray 'outreach_on' hallucination would silently flip autopilot on. System prompt has 'STRICT RULE' but this is soft. Adding a server-side keyword-guardrail check on body.question would make it deterministic.
